bio: Tiara Venier has evolved from a mere dock laborer into a shrewd operator who commands respect through her unmatched knowledge of Venice's maritime trade and her ability to anticipate merchant needs before they voice them. Her accumulated wealth of over 127,000 ducats reflects years of calculated risks and strategic positioning, yet her growing influence has bred a dangerous pride that sometimes blinds her to the shifting loyalties of those around her.
